name: Abua

routes.outcome: Official Rivers State ministries portal was identified by first-party search as the state government service directory, but direct fetch returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. No challenge bypass was attempted.

Official Rivers State budget PDF identifies Ministry of Lands, Office of the Surveyor-General, land plot identification, surveying, and physical-planning activities. This supports state custodianship, not a public parcel API.
Official Rivers State Investment Promotion Agency portal lists the Ministry of Lands and Survey among state MDAs; no parcel map or safe geometry service was exposed.

Public Rivers State Ministry of Physical Planning and Urban Development page was reachable. It exposes planning/layout/application and login-oriented flows, not an anonymous cadastral parcel layer or schema.
Public login route was observed as part of the planning portal. No login was attempted and no credentials, private tokens, or protected data were requested.

Public SGRIV shell identifies itself as Rivers State Office of the Surveyor General land management and presents C-of-O/application/account flows. JavaScript inspection exposed a support endpoint and application shell, but no public map configuration, parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel response.

First-party Office of the Surveyor-General of the Federation site was reachable and describes general requests for maps, coordinates, and cadastral surveys. It is a national agency route, not a Rivers/Abua local parcel service, and no parcel response was requested.
Official INEC locator confirms Abua/Odual administrative context in Rivers State. It is an electoral-office locator, not a cadastral registry, and no parcel fields were requested.

qualification.reason: A Rivers State land/survey custodian and public land-management route are evidenced, but no safe anonymous native-ID polygon response, schema, CRS, or independent adapter behavior was exposed. Runtime qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [4.85144627438892, 6.64793181724718] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel-hit forcing was attempted.

The Rivers State portal returned a Cloudflare challenge; no CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass was attempted. This, the login-oriented routes, and the lack of an exposed parcel response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The national OSGOF route was kept distinct from the Rivers State local/state custodian and was not treated as an Abua parcel service.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe anonymous native ID-plus-geometry response was available.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request captures and scratch evidence belong under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/abua/.
uncertainty: Rivers State publicly evidences land and survey administration and a digital SGRIV application route, and Abua is administratively within Rivers State. Public coverage of Abua, cadastral digitization extent, anonymous viewer/API availability, schema, CRS, native identity, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified. No citywide absence inference is made.
